seo.title: About — Viz Creative
seo.description: Viz Creative is an interior design and 3D visualization studio based in Abuja, Nigeria.

hero.label: Who We Are
hero.heading: Interior design and architectural visualization, built around how spaces are actually used.

intro: Viz Creative is an interior design and 3D visualization studio working across residential, commercial, and hospitality projects in Nigeria and beyond.
We work at the intersection of design and visualization — developing concepts, then rendering them with enough precision that clients can make real decisions before a wall goes up.

process.title: Discovery
process.description: We start by understanding the brief, the site, and the constraints — establishing the foundation everything else builds on.

process.title: Design
process.description: Mood boards, material palettes, lighting plans, and spatial layouts, refined until every element earns its place.

process.title: Visualization
process.description: Photorealistic 3D renders that let you experience a space and make informed decisions before construction begins.

process.title: Implementation
process.description: For turnkey projects, we coordinate vendors, quality control, and installation through to final handover.

cta.label: Collaboration
cta.heading: Have a project in mind? Let's talk it through.
